title: CLO system requirements (July 2025)
content: In this document, CLO or CLO software refers only to the CLO software installed on the user's local computer, and does not refer to CLO-SET and various other CLO products. The hardware components presented in the documents and tables below have been tested directly by the CLO team or are listed based on feedback from CLO users. Please note that CLO team does not provide consulting services such as computer price quotes and hardware performance comparisons. So please carefully review the CLO software installation and operating conditions described below. **Windows** Category | **Minimum** | **Recommended** ---|---|--- OS | Windows 10 64-bit (1903 or later) | Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) 1) 2) 3) 4) Windows 11 64-bit (24H2) Processor | AMD® Ryzen™ 5 1500X Intel® Core-i5 6400 5) | AMD® Ryzen™ 7/9 7000 series or higher Intel® Core-i7/i9 14th Gen or higher Memory | 8GB | 32GB or more 6) Graphics card | AMD, Intel, Nvidia GPUs supporting OpenGL 1.6 or higher | NVIDIA® GeForce RTX series or NVIDIA® Quadro RTX, RTX A, RTX Ada series 7) 8) 9) Storage | HDD 10GB or more | SSD 20GB or more Screen | 1920x1080(FHD) | 2560x1440 (QHD), 3840x2160 (UHD, 4K) Input device | 3-button mouse | 3-button mouse Network | Internet connection required | Internet connection required 1) Windows updates and patches are highly recommended. [Windows Update - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/update-windows-10-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a) 2) Windows 10 will reach end of support on October 14, 2025. <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-10-home-and-pro> 3) If dll-related errors occur while installing or running CLO, install the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable. X64 architecture is recommended. [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable latest supported downloads](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170) 4) CLO software cannot run on Windows 10/11 N which media features removed. Download and install the Media Feature Pack from the Microsoft website**.** [Media Feature Pack for Windows 10/11 N (February 2023)](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/media-feature-pack-for-windows-10-11-n-february-2023-2aaf89b8-f9d3-4322-98d0-612c9bea9c01) 5) A processor that supports [AVX2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advanced_Vector_Extensions) is required to use the V-ray render function built into CLO software. As a simple example, Intel 3rd generation and earlier processors cannot use CLO's V-ray render. 6) For smoother operation, 16GB or more of memory is recommended. 32GB or more of memory is recommended if you are using multiple software at the same time and/or dealing with huge and complex garments. 7) CLO utilizes [Nvidia CUDA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CUDA) acceleration technology for CLO GPU-Simulation and Rendering. So computers with only Intel Graphics or AMD graphics card do not benefit from GPU acceleration that speeds up CLO simulation and rendering. If you want faster GPU-simulation and GPU-rendering in CLO software, look for a computer with a recent Nvidia graphics card. 8) For graphics card related issues, please see the following guide. In particular, please update your graphics card driver to the latest. [Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768) 9) A GPU that supports OpenGL Compatibility Profile 1.6 or higher is required to run CLO software. Some mobile GPU processors from AMD and Intel may not fully support [OpenGL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGL), which is essential for running CLO software, and may not run CLO software. If you are using a laptop or graphics card with a built-in CPU, check with the hardware manufacturer for the GPU model and whether it supports OpenGL. * * * **Mac** Category | **Minimum** | **Recommended** ---|---|--- Mac models | All Macs released after 2016 1) 2) | Apple Silicon Macs: M1, M2, M3, M4 macOS | Monterey 12 *For macOS dependencies, check out the notes below 3) | Ventura 13, Sonoma 14, Sequoia 15 Processor | Intel® Core-i5 4cores | Apple Silicon Chip 4) 5) Memory | 8GB | 24GB or more Storage | HDD 10GB or more | SSD 20GB or more Screen | 1280x800 | Retina 4K, Retina 5K supported Input devices | 3-button mouse | 3-button mouse Network | Internet connection required | Internet connection required 1) Starting with CLO v2024, the minimum macOS has been changed to Monterey 12. See which macs are compatible with macOS Monterey 12 here. [macOS Monterey is compatible with these computers.](https://support.apple.com/en-us/103260) 2) Intel chip macs do not have discrete GPU, so Intel chip mac users cannot make use of GPU acceleration, but 3D garment simulation and vray-rendering works on CPU-based. 3) macOS dependencies * Sierra 10.12: users can install and run up to CLO 5.2. * High Sierra 10.13: users can install and run up to CLO 6.1. * Mojave 10.14: users can install and run up to CLO 6.2. * Catalina 10.15: users can install and run up to CLO 7.3. * Please note that CLO 7.0 and future versions will not run on macOS Mojave or earlier. 4) As of CLO 7.0, provides as a compatible build for both Apple Silicon macs and Intel chip macs. If you want to use version 6.2 or lower on Apple Silicon Mac, you need to install Apple Rosetta. Visit here for more info. [If you need to install Rosetta on your Mac: Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211861) 5) Starting with CLO version 2025.0, V-Ray rendering via GPU acceleration is available on Apple Silicon Macs. It is GPU (Metal) that can be selected from the Render Engine list, and the GPU simulation on Apple Silicon Mac is under research and development. <https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899148-Edit-V-Ray-Render-Properties> * * * **Please note** * CLO software does not support garment pattern digitizers. * CLO software have tested and supports Wacom® tablet products, and compatibility issues may occur with third-party tablets. * CLO software does not support BootCamp in macOS, also does not support similar desktop virtualization apps. * CLO software does not support 32-bit OS (e.g. Windows 7 32-bit), Apple iOS, iPad OS, tvOS, Android OS, ChromeOS, Windows Mobile and Linux. * CLO software can be downloaded as .exe or .dmg file format via [CLO official website](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/download/installer). It is not distributed in .msi or .pkg file format. * CLO software can be installed and run in virtual server environments such as Virtual Machine and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and in cloud services. However, in this case, the CLO team does not provide technical support. **See also** * [Disk access rights required when CLO is running](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697-Disk-access-rights-required-when-CLO-is-running) * [How to Speed Up CLO](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/23390057463577-How-to-Speed-Up-CLO) * [How to Prevent CLO File Corruption](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/23206278838681-How-to-Prevent-CLO-File-Corruption) * [Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768-Graphics-Card-Problems-and-Troubleshooting)
content_description: This webpage provides essential installation and operating requirements for CLO software on Windows and Mac systems, ensuring users understand the necessary hardware specifications for optimal performance.

title: Simulation
content: Use this function to apply gravity and drape 3D garments in the 3D Window. Clicking on the simulate button causes all pattern pieces to fall towards the floor and drape onto avatars and similar (static collision) objects that are in the way. When seamlines are set between pattern pieces, the fabric drapes and falls while the set seamlines are sewn. # **Location** **3D Toolbar ▶** **CPU: Normal (Default)![CPU: Normal \(Default\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856321214489)** **CPU: Fitting (Accurate Fabric)![CPU: Fitting \(Accurate Fabric\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856382868249)** **CPU: Animation (Stable)![CPU: Animation \(Stable\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856321215001)** **GPU: Normal (Default)![GPU: Normal \(Default\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856321215129)** **GPU: Fitting (Accurate Fabric)![GPU: Fitting \(Accurate Fabric\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856382868889)** **GPU: Animation (Stable)![GPU: Animation \(Stable\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53856382869017)** Click and hold the tool to change in between the simulation options in the appearing pop-up window. * * * **Main Menu ▶ 3D ▶ Simulate** # **Simulation Modes** **![CPU: Normal \(Default\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065410464793)![GPU: Normal \(Default\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065410471193)****Normal (Default):** Garment simulation is more efficient with faster speed. **![CPU: Fitting \(Accurate Fabric\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065410467993)![GPU: Fitting \(Accurate Fabric\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065387979161)****Fitting (Accurate Fabric):** Garment simulation is more defined and fabric stretch is expressed more realistically. **![CPU: Animation \(Stable\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065387971609)![GPU: Animation \(Stable\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065410472729)****Animation (Stable):** Garment simulation is more defined but the simulation speed may decrease. # **CPU or GPU?** Switch between how collision is calculated - via processor or graphic card unit. GPU has the same level of accuracy and collision handling as CPU simulation in all modes. For trims, collision and weight only work with CPU simulation.
content_description: Explore our 3D garment draping tool to simulate realistic fabric behavior under gravity, allowing you to see how your designs interact with avatars and static objects in real-time.

title: Measuring a Garment in the 3D Window
content: New garment measures can be placed with the tools **Linear Measure (Garment)** and **Circumference Measure (Garment)**. With **Edit Measure (Garment)** , existing garment measures can be selected, edited, and deleted. These tools function exclusively in the 3D window. # **Location** # **3D Toolbar ▶** **Edit Measure (Garment)![Edit Measure \(Garment\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53807775919897)** **Linear Measure (Garment)![Linear Measure \(Garment\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53807821052697)** **Circumference Measure (Garment)![Circumference Measure \(Garment\) inactive tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53807821053721)** 1. The linear and circumference measuring tools are grouped into one tool group. 2. Keep your left mouse button pressed on one of them to pop up the submenu. * * * **Main Menu ▶ 3D ▶ Measurement ▶** **Edit Measure (Garment)** **Linear Measure (Garment)** **Circumference Measure (Garment)** # **![Edit Measure \(Garment\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065675198105)****Edit Measure (Garment)** Click on a 3D garment measure to edit. → The selected measure is now highlighted. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. **Linear Measure (Garment)** | **Circumference Measure (Garment)** ---|--- **Name** | Rename the measure. | **Name** | Rename the measure. **Length** | Check the length of the measure. | **Surface Length** | Check the length of the measure. **Square Width** | Modify the width of the square that appears at the end of the measure. | **Circle Diameter** | Modify the circle diameter that appears around the measure. # **![Linear Measure \(Garment\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065686021529)****Linear Measure (Garment)** 1. Click once at the beginning point of where you want to start the measure. → A green dot and rectangle appear. 2. Click again to define the endpoint of the measure. → A linear measurement is created and instantly displayed. 3. If you hold Shift on the keyboard, the direction of the measure can be defined in angled increments of 45° instead of freehand. # **![Circumference Measure \(Garment\) active tool icon](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54065686021657)****Circumference Measure (Garment)** Click on an area to measure its circumference. → A circumference measurement is created and instantly displayed.
content_description: This web page provides tools for measuring and editing garment dimensions in a 3D environment, enabling users to accurately create and modify linear and circumference measurements.

title: Material Type
content: **** Express the fabric in various material types! **** 1. Click the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ **Type**. 2. Refer to the table below to adjust fabric gloss and hardware material. **Name** | **Description** ---|--- **Type** | Choose the reflection type to express fabric gloss more realistically as needed. **Fabric_Matte** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express general fabric. **Fabric_Shiny** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express shiny fabric. **Fabric_Silk/Satin** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express silk or satin fabric. **Fabric_Velvet** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express velvet fabric. [**Denim**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/48703338325145-Express-Denim-Wet-Wash) | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48709108912665) Express Denim wet wash effects. [**Fur_(Render Only)**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001526568) | Express realistic fur. **Gem (Render Only)** | Express gem material. Gem material is similar with glass, but expresses light reflection in multiple color. Adjust the opacity with the **Absorption** value. Lower the value is, more transparent the object is. The **Absorption** value is relative to the object's thickness. Thicker the object is, lower the **Absorption** value should be. Adjust the **Abbe** value to increase or reduce light reflection effect. **Glass** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express glass materials. Adjust the opacity with the **Absorption** value. Lower the value is, more transparent the object is. The **Absorption** value is relative to the object's thickness. Thicker the object is, lower the **Absorption** value should be. [**Glitter (Render Only)**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011005813) | Express glitter. **Light (Render Only)** | Use garments or objects as lights. Adjust the brightness with the **Color Mult** option. Higher the value is, brighter the light is. As the light gets brighter, the color of the light deviates from the one set by the user. **Leather** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express leathers. **Metal** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express metallic materials. **Plastic** | Reflection is adjusted optimal to express plastics. **Skin (Render Only)** | Render human skin more realistically. Light enters an object and scatters beneath its surface. Not all light reflects from a surface. The objects penetrating lights such as leaves, fruits, or candles also be used for this. **📝Note:** When using Skin, you should not use a displacement map since the compatibility issue with V-Ray. **Roughness** | **Intensity** | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting **Intensity** of the**Roughness**. **📝Note:** Since**** version **2024.0** , the Roughness Intensity ranges have been expanded. When loading legacy files, the displayed value is automatically converted (e.g., 50 becomes 100) to maintain the same visual appearance and compatibility. **Map** | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying **Roughness Map**. **Map** | Select the **Browse** button next to the **Map** option to add a **Roughness Map** to the selected Fabric style. **Map Intensity** | Adjust the Map's **Intensity**. **📝Note:** Since**** version **2024.0** , the Roughness Intensity ranges have been expanded. When loading legacy files, the displayed value is automatically converted (e.g., 50 becomes 100) to maintain the same visual appearance and compatibility. **Invert** | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in CLO below ver4.0.0, check this option. **Reflection Intensity** | Greater the **Reflection Intensity** value is, more reflective the material or fabric is and vice-versa.
content_description: Explore and customize the expressiveness of various fabric materials by adjusting their gloss and reflection properties to achieve realistic visual effects.

title: Troubleshooting: Vray Render Problems
content: This article describes the causes and solutions to various problems that may occur during V-ray rendering in CLO software. If your CLO rendering is not working, freezing or extremely slow, please take a closer look at this article. And please note that this article does not describe everything related to rendering, but rather describes the main causes of problems and how to mitigate them. ![Lady_in_Hanbok_png.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44490647923481) <The image above is an example of a traditional woman dress rendered using V-ray in CLO software.> ## **Technical background** CLO software includes the [V-Ray Render SDK from Chaos](https://www.chaos.com/vray), allowing users to create photorealistic renders of their projects, including clothing and avatars. CLO's V-ray renderer supports both Windows and macOS, and can complete rendering faster via GPU acceleration, especially on Windows PCs equipped with Nvidia graphics cards. On Windows PCs and Macs without an Nvidia graphics card, rendering will be done via the CPU, and the results of CPU-based and GPU-based rendering will be almost identical. And one good news, starting with CLO v2025.0, GPU acceleration is available for V-ray rendering on Apple Silicon Macs. In the Render Engine list, you can choose GPU (Metal) in addition to CPU. Also note that acceleration performance via GPU (Metal) depends on the specifications of the GPU cores built into the Apple Silicon Mac and the CLO garment file and its properties. ## **Render Properties** ![004_render_properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44375524368025) ### Render Engine * **CPU** : This is the default render engine for CLO and will be locked to this engine on Windows PCs and Macs without Nvidia graphics cards. * **GPU (CUDA)** : This is an option for Windows PCs with Nvidia graphics cards. If you have a modern, high-performance Nvidia GPU, you can complete rendering about 2 to 6 times faster than CPU-based rendering. When rendering very light clothing, like a basic CLO t-shirt, there isn't much difference between GPU and CPU render times. GPU rendering is an option to choose when you want to process very complex and heavy garments quickly, and to do so, you need the latest high-performance Nvidia GPUs. * **CPU Supporting** : This feature adds idle CPU resources during GPU rendering to help render faster and smoother. We recommend leaving this option turned on. * **Low GPU Priority** : This will lower the GPU resources consumed during GPU rendering. You can turn this option on if you want to do other image/video work while rendering, but for fast and stable rendering, you may want to leave it off. ### Finish Conditions * Finish Conditions are literally options that determine how the render will be finished. * **Noise Threshold** : This determines how much noise will be suppressed in the rendered result image. The lower this value is, the better the rendered image quality is. However, as more calculations are performed, computing resources and rendering time increase dramatically. **Even with the default value of 0.05, sufficient quality rendering results can be obtained.** If you want to obtain better quality rendered images, try rendering while lowering this value step by step, like 0.05 > 0.04 > 0.03, and check the final quality. At the lowest values ​​near 0.001, it will take a long time to complete the render even on a high-performance computer. * **Max Render Time (min)** : This is a kind of timer, and when the time set here is elapsed, the render engine will stop even if the rendering has not completed yet. Lowering this value will not make rendering complete any faster. So if you set this value too low, you may see a rough rendered image result because it will stop in an unfinished rendering state. **It is actually better to set it to the maximum value of 100 minutes.** ## **Image/Video Properties** ![003_render_image_properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44374636184729) ### Image Size * As the image size increases, the amount of pixels the renderer has to process (i.e. the amount of computation) increases, which in turn increases the usage of the CPU, GPU, video memory, main memory, and the time to complete. If you want to render very large image sizes, make sure your computer is powerful enough to handle it, especially with plenty of memory. Most rendering scenarios can be handled well on a PC with around 32GB of memory and/or around 16GB of video memory, but scenarios such as super large image sizes or animation rendering may run into memory shortage issues. * If you need to continuously process sequential image scenes, such as turntable rendering, animation rendering, and colorway rendering, the load on your hardware and memory usage can increase significantly. Even in rendering scenarios that process sequential scenes like this, keep a close eye on memory usage. ## **Interactive Render vs. Final Render** * Interactive Render is a function that instantly renders changes to the scene that occur when you rotate or scale a garment in the 3D window, showing them within the Render window. That is, since it is a mode for fast and instantaneous rendering results, the image quality and details are reduced compared to Final Render. * Final Render is a function that renders based on the current garment and given render settings and saves the result as an image file or video. Even after Final Render is completed, you need to check the result saved as a file, not the result shown in the render window, to confirm the exact rendered result. Additionally, slight differences in image quality, color, and color tone may occur depending on the image/video viewer program. ## **Problem situations and how to solve them** * **"My computer has an Nvidia graphics card but GPU rendering is not enabled"** : This is either because the GPU device is disabled in Windows, the graphics card and monitor are not properly connected, or because of a graphics card driver error. Please check [this web post](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768-Graphics-Card-Problems-and-Troubleshooting) for solutions. * **"Can't render with Intel Graphics or AMD GPU?"** : CLO software supports both CPU and GPU rendering, with GPU rendering only available on PCs with Nvidia graphics cards and Apple Silicon Macs. Windows PCs with AMD or Intel graphics cards, and older Intel-chip-based Macs, only support CPU rendering. * **"So slow, rendering has been taking hours"** : Depending on how complex and heavy your project is, your computer's specifications, and the Render Finish Conditions described above, the render completion time will vary. Try rendering again after loosening the details and properties of the garment itself, as well as the render properties. * **"Freezing or crash happens while rendering"** : As above, it is a result of the complexity of the project, computer specifications, and rendering properties. Sometimes, crashes or rendering failures may occur due to graphics card driver errors, in which case, try updating to the latest graphics card drivers. * **"It shows out of video memory error"** : This occurs when there is not enough video memory to complete the rendering. Please readjust the render properties and image size, close all other programs using video memory, and then try rendering again. For example, starting Windows and opening just a web browser can take up about 600MB to 1GB of video memory. Under these conditions, if your graphics card has 8GB of video memory, your CLO will only be able to use about 7GB of video memory. So if you are running multiple programs in addition to the CLO software, it is recommended that you close them before rendering, as the CLO renderer may run out of video memory. * **"Rendering stops with an unknown error message"** : This is due to a setting error in Windows itself and/or a graphics card driver error. Update to the latest graphics card driver. * **"Garments containing fur and/or knitwear fabrics cannot be rendered, or it shows unexpected render results"** : Fur and knitwear rendering are among the most hardware-intensive of CLO's features. They require several to tens of times more calculations and use more memory than other clothing renderings. If your computer is struggling to handle this scenario, consider designing approaches that use images or textures to represent fur and knitwear. * **"GPU render results are slightly different from CPU render results"** : This is due to the nature of the V-Ray render SDK and may occur when rendering scenes with a large number of light sources and reflections, and very complex fabrics such as fur. This is a known issue for the CLO team and are continuously working on improving it. * **"V-Ray render cannot run because the required V-Ray library could not be loaded in the current environment"** : The CLO software is designed to load configuration files when starting vray-render. This error indicates that essential files for vray-render could not be loaded due to file permissions. The solution is to install the CLO software with administrator privileges, see [details here](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697-Disk-access-rights-required-when-CLO-is-running#:~:text=to%20download%22%20appears.-,Windows,-1%C2%A0%20After%20logging). Security programs, such as antivirus programs, may restrict the execution of the CLO software or various files that comprise CLO. In the detailed settings of the installed or running security program, change both the execution of the CLO software and Internet connection to "Allow." ![008_vray_lib_load_fail.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54219419608473) ## **How to check GPU and video memory usage** * You can check CPU, Memory, GPU, and GPU memory usage in the Performance tab of Windows Task Manager. Below, running just Windows and a web browser, you can see very low CPU and GPU usage, but you can see that the base memory usage is quite high. * When you run CLO to perform tasks like pattern editing, simulation, rendering, etc., you will see increased CPU, GPU, and memory usage. And it is normal for CPU and GPU usage to be close to 100% during simulation and rendering, and GPU usage will not stay at 100% during GPU-rendering. While GPU rendering, GPU usage continues to fluctuate because it is divided into sections where the GPU works, sections where the CPU works, and sections where they work simultaneously. ![007_GPU_usage.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44417445932569) The image above is what Windows Task Manager looks like during interactive-GPU-rendering. The Windows desktop PC specifications and project file details used for testing are as follows: * AMD Ryzen™ 9 7950X Processor (native 16-core), Nvidia RTX™ A6000 (vram 48GB), 64GB DDR5 memory, NVMe SSD 512GB, 4K resolution monitor, wired internet connection * Windows 11 Pro version 24H2 (OS Build 26100.3476), CLO v2024.2.328 * A traditional dress made of multiple layers, particle distance from 5 to 20, no trim, made with 55 patterns and 1144 sewing lines. Check out the links below for file download and tutorial. * CONNECT store: <https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/99263/collection/collections?itemId=5af7734d050c4e31987061fbf697a3a9> * YouTube tutorial: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T_UbvoshTpA> **1) CPU** : shows CPU usage. It doesn't always use 100% during rendering and it fluctuates. **2) Memory** : this is the total amount of memory used by Windows, the web browser, and CLO rendering. Windows itself uses about 4GB of memory, and the web browser uses about the same amount. The CLO software uses about 5 to 6GB of memory to do this level of garment rendering. Memory usage will vary depending on OS, hardware configuration, active programs, CLO garment files, and properties. **3) GPU** : shows GPU name and current usage. If you have a laptop or desktop with both integrated graphics and a discrete graphics card, you will see more than one GPU listed. As with CPU usage, it is not always 100% and fluctuates. **4) Dedicated GPU Memory** : shows the total amount of video memory installed on the graphics card and the currently used amount. Windows itself typically uses about 600MB to 1GB of video memory, and web browsers and other programs with graphical UI use a similar amount of video memory. Rendering in CLO typically starts at around 3GB of video memory, and can even use 20GB or more for very complex, continuous image processing scenarios such as animation rendering. Mac users who want to check hardware resources while running CLO software can use the [Activity Monitor](https://support.apple.com/guide/activity-monitor/welcome/mac) app which built in macOS. ## **See also** * [CLO system requirements](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168-CLO-system-requirements-March-2025) * [Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768-Graphics-Card-Problems-and-Troubleshooting) * [How to workaround errors caused by faulty GPU drivers](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/44142966593177-How-to-workaround-errors-caused-by-faulty-GPU-drivers-Last-modified-Mar-2025) * [How to speed up CLO](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/23390057463577-How-to-Speed-Up-CLO)

title: Keyframe Animation
content: ## **New in CLO 2025.0** Add Keyframe Set Animation Layer Animation Track Set Keyframe Timleline Supported Objects By setting animation keys on an object’s properties, you can interpolate between keyframes to express animation over time. Edit the avatar’s joints to apply dynamic animations, or control the wind properties tocreate effects where the wind values change over time. Use these methods to create various animation effects. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947169529881) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/p2oEiVd6_ZM) #### **Add Keyframe** 1. Click Animation ▶ **Animation Editor** in the top menu. 2. Click the **Add Animation** button at the top left of the Animation Editor to view a list of objects that can have animations. 3. Select the target item to create an empty layer with no keyframes. 4. Expand the created layer, set the value of a property that can be keyed, and click the **![Insert Key.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53244832282137)Insert Key** button. _* This action works the same as clicking**Insert Key** in the Property Editor._ __ 5. Move the **Current Frame** , change the property value, and click **Insert Key** again to create another keyframe. 6. When you play the animation between the multiple keyframes, you can see the value change over time. #### **Animation Layer** 1. Right-clicking the created layer will display a context menu. 2. Layer have a hierarchical structure, and only the properties of an object that can be keyed are displayed as layers. 3. Layers can be deleted, and sub-property layers can be re-created using the **Add Layer** menu of the parent layer. 4. An animation list item is structured as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Active Button** | When the button is turned on, the keyframes in the layer become active and functional. Child layers are dependent on the active status of their parent layer. **Layer Name** | The top-level layer displays its name along with an icon. Property layers display only the name. The layer name is synchronized with the actual target’s name. **Parameter Value** | Shows the value of the corresponding property and allows you to edit it. This value is synchronized with the Property Editor and will update together. **Key Controller** | Enables the insertion of keyframes and provides navigation to the previous or next keyframe. **📝Note:** Recorded **Cache Layer** only can be cut or merged. #### **Animation Track** 1. **Top Level Object Layer** * The object layer displays the Start-End keyframe range as a bar. * Hover the mouse over the bar to display the handles and precisely adjust its length. * As the length of the bar changes, the keyframes in the child layers stretch or shrink while maintaining their relative spacing. 2. **Property Layer** * Actual keyframes are set on property layers. * Property layers can also be grouped, and the parent key in the group represents the keys of its children. * When the parent key is selected, all child keys on the same frame are selected as well, and actions such as moving, copying, deleting, or changing interpolation type are applied collectively. #### **Set Keyframe** 1. **Manual Keyframe Creation** * Change the property value of the target object in the Animation Layer or Property Editor, then click the **Intert Keyframe** button. * The current property value of the target object will be set as a key at the current frame. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** 2. **Automatic Keyframe Creation** * Enable **Auto Keying**. * Manually set the first key using the manual creation method. * After the initial key is set, any changes to the same property will automatically create a key at the current frame. **📝Note:** The first key must be manually set in order for subsequent keys to be created automatically on that property. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51957439965465) 3. **Create Keyframes or Layers in Batch** * When ![Add Keyframe for Selected Layers.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53244816870809) **Add Keyframe for Selected Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all currently selected layers. * When ![Add Keyframe for All Layers.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53244816877337) **Add Keyframe for All Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all layers. * When ![Create All Object Layers.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53244816880281) **Create All Object Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , layers are created for all scene objects existing in the current world. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** 4. **Copy and Paste Keyframes** * One or more keyframes can be copied and pasted relative to the current frame. * Meaningful paste results can only be achieved when pasting onto layers with the same data type. * When multiple keys are pasted, they retain the same spacing relative to the current frame. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** 5. **Keyframe Interpolation Types** * To set the interpolation type, select keys and right-click to open the context menu. Choose the desired interpolation type from the menu. * Keyframe interpolation types can be set as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Linear** | Creates a straight-line interpolation between keys, producing a constant rate of change. **Cubic** | Creates a curved interpolation between keys, resulting in dynamic changes. This is visible when three or more keys are present. **Constant** | Maintains the current key's value until just before the next key. * To apply the same interpolation type to all child keys, select the parent key of the property and change its interpolation type. All child keys will be updated accordingly. #### **Timeline** **Playback Range Context Menu** 1. Use the following features to easily set the playback range. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Set Start Frame** | Sets the current frame as the start frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is larger than the end frame. **Set End Frame** | Sets the current frame as the end frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is less than the start frame. **Clamp Range to Active Frames** | Automatically adjusts the playback range to fit the span between the first and last keyframes across all layers. _**✨Tip:** _Quickly adjust the animation playback range based on specific layers. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947169529881) Watch Video](https://youtu.be/WIQVkxGPmB4?si=tJ_6-OMdOkfWcnK_) Use **Clamp Range to Selected Layers** from the track context menu of an animation layer to adjust the playback range. The range will automatically match the start and end keyframes of the selected layers. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** **Slider Context Menu** 1. Right-click the slider at the bottom of the Timeline and use the following options to control the Timeline view area. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Fit to Active Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Start Keyframe and End Keyframe. **Fit to Playback Range** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Playback Range's Start Frame and End Frame. **Fit to Full Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fir the defined Minimum Frame and Maximum Frame. #### **Supported Objects** Keyframe animation can be applied to the following objects: **Object** | **Description** ---|--- **Colorway** | The following properties can be controlled: \- Colorways **📝Note:** Keyframe can be inserted by clicking the **Insert Key** button located at the top right of the Colorway Editor. **Fabric** | The following properties can be controlled: * Front/Back/Side Material * Physical Property **📝Note:** If **Use Same Material as Front** is enabled for the back/side material, it will not appear in the Layer. **Pattern** | The following properties can be controlled: * Fabric Index * Solidify * Shrinkage Weft/ Warp (%) * Pressure **📝Note:** It is possible to transition between fabrics assigned to a pattern. When switching fabrics, the property values are interpolated. **Avatar** | The following properties can be controlled: * Joint **Trim** | The following properties can be controlled: * Weight (g) **Camera** | The following properties can be controlled: * Transform * Local Camera Position * Aim Position * Field of View **Pin** | The following properties can be controlled: * Activate **Tack** | The following properties can be controlled: * Activate * Thread Length (mm) **Wind Controller** | The following properties can be controlled: * Active * Unlimited Bound * Transform * Strength * Decay * Frequency * Turbulence **Simulation Property** | The following properties can be controlled: * Gravity * Air Damping **Cache** | Recorded Cache is classified into the following two types. * Garment Cache Caches recorded during simulation are keyed and categorized into Pattern and Trim Layers. * Softbody Cache Avatar motion recorded after enabling Softbody. **📝Note:** Cache layers can be cut and merged individually by type. **Render Light** | Apply keyframes to [render lights](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899168-Edit-V-Ray-Light-Properties). **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49947670722969)** * **Rectangle Light** \- Activate \- Intensity \- Color \- Width \- Height * **Sphere Light** \- Activate \- Intensity \- Color \- Radius * **Directional Light** \- Activate \- Intensity \- Color * **Spot Light** \- Activate \- Intensity \- Color \- Cone Angle \- Penumbra Angle \- Shadow Radius * **IES Light** \- Activate \- Color \- If Intensity is set to Custom: Intensity Value * **Dome Light** \- Activate \- Light Intensity \- Light Angle _If Finite Dome is activated: Even when switched to Off while a key is set as On, the animation layer will not be visible, but the key value will be retained._ \- Radius \- Projection Height \- Ground Blend
content_description: Discover the powerful new animation features in CLO 2025.0, including keyframe sets and dynamic animation tracks, to bring your designs to life with intricate motion and effects.

title: Pattern Drafter
content: ## **New in 2025.0** Open Set Measurement Options AI Pattern Drafter (Beta) **** Easily Create your First Pattern within CLO, using either measurement points or your flat sketches.![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45053653355417) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/X0GSGKGGYaM) #### **Open** 1. Click the 2D ▶ **Pattern Drafter** in the top menu. 2. Choose a Pattern Type to start drafting your patterns. #### #### **Set Measurements Options** 1. You have 3 different options for how you want to view and adjust your measurements for your patterns. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **General** | This will give you a complete list of the most commonly used Points of Measure for that style. **Simple** | This will give you the most commonly used points of measure for simple editing of patterns. **Custom** | This is automatically adjust to Custom when you select your own measurement list and customize to your preference. 1\. Click ![setting.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774347289) **Setting** button to view the full list of measurements. 2\. Use the checkbox to show or hide items as needed. 3\. Once setup is complete, click ![Total-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774352537) **Exit** button to apply changes. 2. Enter your pattern measurement values. _**✨Tip:** _ **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **![reset.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585790784793)Reset** | Return each measurement to its original value individually. **![Total.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774384537)Total** | Certain Measurements include the Toptal option to input the full front and back circumference. **Base** | Certain measurements include dropdown options, as they are commonly taken from different areas of the pattern. E.g. **\- Total Length:** High Point Shoulder, Or Center Front/ Back **\- Across Front/ Back:** 4", 5" or 6" from High Point Shoulder **\- Across Waist:** 4", 5" or 6" from Armhole **\- Across Bust/ Chest:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole **\- Bicep Width:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole **Symmetry** | Set the front and back pattern to Symmetry or Half Symmetry ![list.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45586096388121) **Show All Measurement** | View all inactive measurements in each section. #### #### **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** Using a Sketch CLO will Automatically generate measurements to create a drafted pattern for you. 1. Click **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** button on the top right of the Pattern Drafter. 2. Generate a background image to be composited by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Select the garment type and write in your sketch idea. Make sure to add in as many descriptive words as possible. if you want to emphasize something place it in brackets. **✨ Writing Tips:** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052844441)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052847001)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Pattern image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052849049) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly ![Editor Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052849945) **Clear** | Clear anything that was written to restart. **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to add any garment or pattern image. 3. Click ![Generate.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052851097) button and an image will be generated for you to choose from. This process can be replicated until you get the desired outcome. Your image history can be found on the right side of the window.
content_description: Discover the innovative AI Pattern Drafter (Beta) in CLO 2025.0, enabling you to effortlessly create patterns from measurement points or sketches with customizable options for enhanced design flexibility.

title: How can I get a trial version of CLO?
content: **Question** How can I get a trial version of CLO? **Answer** CLO offers a CLO free trial for 14 days, and all users eligible for an Individual license can use a one-time free trial. *Your paid subscription will automatically start right after the trial expires and you can cancel your trial before renewal, avoiding charges. **Important Note:** To receive the student discount, you must verify your student status before starting your trial. If you fail to do so, you will not be eligible for the discount. [Does CLO offer student discounts?](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013366988-Does-CLO-offer-student-discounts) **Eligibility for a CLO free trial** CLO Trial License can be started via the subscription button on the CLO web and is strictly reserved for a hobbyist, freelancer, self-employed individual, or one person-company who qualifies for an Individual License according to our [Terms of Service](https://legal.clo-set.com/additional-clo) (2.2.1). *Enterprise and Academic entities must contact CLO Business Development Team via Contact Us separately to obtain the appropriate Trial License. **Start your CLO free trial** You must sign up first if you don't have a CLO account yet. 1. Click the **FREE TRIAL** button on the main banner or at the top right side of [clo3d.com](https://www.clo3d.com/en/) or the 'GET STARTED' button on the [subscription page](https://clo3d.com/en/plans). 2. Choose the license plan. 1. The chosen plan will get started after your trial expiration. 3. Review your order, enter your billing address, and click the 'Continue' button. 4. Enter your payment information on the final checkout page. 1. If you have already used the same payment information with other accounts, you will see a payment failure. Then, please click the 'SKIP Trial button'. 5. Download a CLO installer and start your free trial. *if you have already downloaded the CLO trial version, you can go to the[ download page](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/download) for a CLO installer.
content_description: Discover how to easily start your 14-day free trial of CLO and explore its features, while ensuring eligibility for student discounts and avoiding automatic charges after the trial ends.

title: Edit Measurement

title: Can I use my subscription offline?
content: **Question** Can I use my subscription offline? **Answer** No, CLO for Individuals, a subscription-based plan, cannot be used offline. Please note that your device must be connected to the internet when you log in to access CLO.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to inform users that the CLO for Individuals subscription requires an internet connection for access and cannot be used offline.

title: Can I use my license on multiple devices?
content: **Question** Can I use my license on multiple devices? **Answer** Yes, you can install and use CLO on another computer. However, you cannot access CLO on multiple computers at the same time. To use CLO on a new computer, you must first log out of the software on your current one. If you are unable to log out (for example, due to an unexpected shutdown), you will need to manually remove your device. Please refer to the following article for instructions: [Remove Device from CLO website](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500000942261-Remove-Device-from-CLO-website) For [CLO for Enterprise](https://www.clo3d.com/enterprise), please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](https://www.clo3d.com/support/contactus). *CLO software provides only on Windows/ macOS, not on mobile or iPad. Please refer to the [CLO System Requirements](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168-CLO-system-requirements-June-2021-) for more information on the device specification.
content_description: This page provides essential information on using your CLO license across multiple devices, including installation instructions and device management guidance.

title: I get the pop-up about the suspension of Individual plan. What should I do?
content: **Question** I get the pop-up about the suspension of Individual plan. What should I do? I can see the watermark in the middle of the CLO screen. **Answer** If you see this pop-up and watermark on your CLO screen, this means you are potentially in violation of CLO license policy and are belonging to one of the following: * a member of an entity that has at least one(1) full-time employee other than you. * making purchases of our Services or CLO Software using a corporate credit card. * registering for a CLO account using a corporate email account, corporate email address, or corporate domain name. * accessing the CLO Software through a computer owned by an Enterprise/Academic entity. Please note that the eligibility of Individual plan is a one-person company, a sole proprietorship, a single-member LLC that does not elect to be treated as a corporation for tax purposes (“disregarded entity”), a freelancer, a self-employed independent contractor, or similarly situated self-employee otherwise in business for yourself. To remove the suspension for Individual subscription, you need to be verified through independent documentation such as articles of incorporation, business registration, tax returns/filings, proof of Self-Employment Tax payment, etc. Please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact) with your account and corresponsive documentation.
content_description: This web page provides guidance for users encountering a suspension pop-up on their CLO account, outlining steps to rectify license policy violations and restore access.

title: Does CLO offer refunds?
content: **Question** Does CLO offer refunds? **Answer** Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds as stated within CLO's Terms of Service agreement. However, in limited cases, **a self-service refund is available within 24 hours of your first billing after a free trial**. You can find more details in this article: [Self-Service Refunds Within 24 Hours of First Billing After Free Trial](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/46600845755161-Self-Service-Refunds-Within-24-Hours-of-First-Billing-After-Free-Trial) Please note that CLO provides auto-renewal subscriptions for individual users, showing a clear notification on the checkout page and asking for your consent before you purchase CLO, as shown below. *Auto-renewal and cancellation policy * Your subscription will automatically renew each billing cycle (monthly or annually, depending on your plan) until canceled. Your selected payment method will be charged at the beginning of each billing period. * You may cancel at any time from your Subscription page to avoid future charges. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle, and you will retain access to your account until that date. No refunds will be issued for the current billing cycle. * Upon cancellation, you will receive a confirmation email from CLO. If you do not receive a cancellation confirmation email within 24 hours, it is your responsibility to promptly contact CLO to obtain written confirmation. Without such confirmation, your cancellation request will be considered invalid. * Individual users are eligible for a refund within 24 hours of the first billing renewal following the free trial. Refunds can be approved automatically during this 24-hour window. If you receive a refund confirmation email without having requested a refund, or notice any suspicious activity, please contact us immediately. ---
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to clarify CLO's refund policy, including details on self-service refunds available within 24 hours of the first billing after a free trial and the auto-renewal subscription terms.

title: Is it OK to use non-genuine CLO software?
content: **Question** Is it OK to use non-genuine CLO software? **Answer** CLO Virtual Fashion Inc. does not approve the supply or use of non-genuine CLO software, and it is not “OK.” Furthermore, spyware and viruses can be spread using non-genuine CLO software. According to IDC, firms that receive or install unauthorized software or purchase a computer with unlicensed software have a one-in-three probability of encountering malware (29 percent). To protect you against non-genuine CLO software, please purchase from [clo3d.com](https://www.clo3d.com/pricing) or [an authorized reseller](https://www.clo3d.com/business/partners) to ensure that you are getting authentic CLO software. CLO works hard to keep you safe from fraudulent sellers by ensuring that only genuine CLO software is available for purchase. ****If you are seeing this popup even after downloading the software from the official CLO website, please try the following methods.** ![20251202_110045.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/52945840727321) * Try closing CLO completely and then launching it again. * Wait for 15 minutes after closing CLO. Then, log into the CLO website and navigate to your user account page. If the 'Remove Device' button is active, click it and then try to launch CLO again. * If the methods above do not work, please try uninstalling and then reinstalling CLO. If none of these solutions resolve the issue, please [contact us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) for further assistance.
content_description: This web page aims to inform users about the risks of using non-genuine CLO software and to guide them towards purchasing authentic software to ensure safety and compliance.

title: MetaHuman DNA Importer
content: **New in CLO 2025.2** [**MetaHuman**](https://www.metahuman.com/en-US) is a next-generation digital human creation technology introduced by Epic Games, offering ultra-realistic character modeling and rigging that are almost indistinguishable from reality. Based on high-resolution 3D scans of real people, it enables precise expression of facial features, skin textures, hair, and body proportions, and works seamlessly with **Unreal Engine** for use in virtual fittings, films, games, and more. Now, **CLO** allows direct import of **MetaHuman DNA data** , enabling garment creation that reflects realistic facial structures and body proportions with exceptional accuracy. **📝****Note:** DNA is the file format (*.dna) used for MetaHuman data. 1. Prepare the Body and Head files (*.dna) extracted from the MetaHuman Editor (Unreal Engine). 2. Go to **File → Import/Import (Add) → DNA** to open the **MetaHuman DNA Importer**. 3. Load both the Body and Head DNA files. 4. Set the import options as needed. **Options** | **Description** ---|--- **File** | **Body** | Load the Body file of the MetaHuman. **Head** | Load the Head file of the MetaHuman. **Basic** | **Unit** | Select the desired unit and enter the scale as a numerical value. **Options** | **Auto Add Arrangement Points** | For humanoid avatars only, arrangement points are automatically generated in the import process. **Auto Create Fitting Suit** | For humanoid avatars only, a Fitting Suit is automatically created in the import process. **Axis Conversion** | Modifying Object's Axis direction. 5. A seamless MetaHuman that combines the head and body will be imported as an avatar type. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51882599850009)** **📝****Note:** * Enable **Avatar Display → Show Avatar Joint** to control the pose in your desired form. * Create animations by setting keyframes on the joints. * Applying motion files(*.mtn) is not supported.
content_description: Discover how CLO 2025.2 integrates Epic Games' MetaHuman technology to enable the creation of ultra-realistic garments using precise digital human modeling and rigging.

title: Import All PBR Maps Once
content: Prepare PBR Images File Naming Rule Import PBR Images Import other PBR maps once after importing a Base Color Map. #### **Prepare PBR Images** 1. Gather all PBR map images in the same folder on the PC. 2. Change images’ names according to the file naming rule. → Apply the rules for importing all PBR Maps. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153023120153) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44161076961305) #### **File Naming Rule** Follow the image naming rule with 3 components with the order 'Image Name_PBR Map Name' * **Image Name** It should be placed at the beginning. The name can be customized. Use the same image name to recognize that those map images are in the same group. * **Underscore _** It should be placed in the middle. * **PBR Map Name** It should be placed at the end. The name needs to follow the chart below. Affect the image import position in CLO Property Editor. **PBR Map** | **Name** | **Example** ---|---|--- **Base Color Map** | Image Name Image Name_BASE Image Name_basecolor Image Name_color Image Name_COL Image Name_diffuse Image Name_DIFF | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153023121305) **Normal Map** | Image Name_normal Image Name_NRM | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153012931993) **Displacement Map** | Image Name_displacement Image Name_DISP Image Name_height | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153012933657) **Opacity Map** | Image Name_opacity Image Name_OPA Image Name_alpha Image Name_ALP | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153023152665) **Roughness Map** | Image Name_roughness Image Name_ROUGH | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153023154201) **Metalness Map** | Image Name_metalness Image Name_MTL | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153012936985) **📝Note:** * Uppercase and lowercase letters are acceptable. * Image Name can be in English or Chinese wording. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44161076961305) #### **Import PBR Images** 1. Import a Base Color Map in Property Editor; or add a new Base Color Map to replace the existing Base Color Map in Property Editor. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153012939673) 2. Click **Yes** or **No** in the popup menu. → Click **Yes** to add Base Color Map and other PBR maps in Property Editor simultaneously. → Click **No** to add Base Color Map only. Other PBR maps in Property Editor won't be imported or updated. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44153012940697)
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions on preparing and importing PBR images with specific file naming rules to ensure proper organization and functionality in the CLO Property Editor.

In the Property Editor, click the ![More.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44161782045721) **More** icon at the far right next to a map, then click 'Open Texture Editor'. ![Fabric Properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44161809573017) #### **Image Layer** 1. Select and Import desired artboards and layers from AI/PDF files. **Copy** | Select the added layer and click the Copy button to copy it. **Lock** | Click the Lock button to lock the layer so that it is not edited. **Layer Order** | Click and drag the layer to change the order. **Show** | Click the Show(eye) icon to view or hide the layer on the window. **Delete** | Click the Delete button to delete the layer. **Rename** | Double-click the name of the layer to edit it and press enter to apply it. #### **Canvas Setting** 1. Set the Image properties of the selected layer in the Properties list at the bottom right of the Texture Editor. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Paint** | **Blend** | Mix the selected layer with the bottom layer. title: UV Editor
content: **List of Contents** **Open UV Editor** **Move UV** **Auto UV Packing** **UV Options** **Bake Textures** **UV Snapshot** **** Create UV maps of patterns, buttons, zippers and more to bake normal, roughness, metalness, and alpha maps. U is the horizontal axis and V is the vertical axis in the graph. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45595894327961) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gt-YmEutZbk) #### **Open UV Editor** 1. Select Materials/UV ▶ **UV Editor** in the top menu. 2. Click the Map icon at the top-left corner of the UV Editor to switch to a different PBR map. #### **** #### **Move UV** 1. Click **Move UV** tool. 2. Set the moving distance. Distance 1 indicates the length of the segment of the UV Tile in the UV Editor. 3. Move the UV by clicking the arrow icon or pressing the directional keys on the keyboard. → UV is moved according to the distance you set. 4. Or click a pattern and drag to move its UVs. #### **** #### **Auto UV Packing** 1. Click**Auto UV Packing** tool. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701576108569) Watch Video](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=9IysllLmqtyUXtAV&t=4306) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Option** | **Padding** | Sets the spacing between UVs. Values ​​are applied in a fraction of the UV tile size. (0.001 ~ 0.999) **Fidelity** | Adjust UV accuracy from 1 to 5. The higher the value, the more accurate the placement is as it is calculated in the original form, but as the amount of calculation increases, it takes more time. **Fix Scale Ratio** | Fix the size ratio of UVs. **Advanced Placement** | It is calculated in a more advanced way and is placed with optimal results with minimal empty space, but the larger the number of patterns, the more time it takes. **UV Area** | **0-1 (Default)** | Set to default 0-1 tile. **Selected Tile** | Set by directly entering UV coordinates. #### **UV Options** ## ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51789054610329) 1. Right-click on the desired pattern. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Select** | **All with Same Property** | All Patterns with the same particle distance, Layer and Fabric will be selected. **Select All Sewn** | Selects all patterns sewn to the initially selected pattern. 2. Or right-click on the background. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Arrange with UV** **(0-1)** | Fit All UV to 0-1. **Length (Absolute)** | Enter the actual distance value from the outline to offset the distance. **UV Coordinate (Relative)** | Enter a value between 0-1 from the outline to offset the distance. **Reset UV to 2D Arrangement** | Reset all UV to 2D Arrangements. #### #### **UV Bake Textures** 1. Click **Bake Textures** tool. 2. After setting the following options, click **Save**. **Options** | **Description** ---|--- **Saving Path** | Specify the saving path and the format (PNG / JPEG / PDF) for baked textures. **Size (Pixels)** | Set the size of the image. The image is saved as a square. **UV Area** | **0-1 (Default)** | Save the default 0-1 tile. **Selected Tile** | Save 1 selected tile. If users enter the UV coordinates to be saved, only one tile is saved. **All Tiles** | Save all tiles. **Fill Texture Seams** | The texture fills outside the seamline by the entered value in pixels. **Infinite Seams** | Fill the seamline to the entire area outside of the pattern. **Texture Type** | Select the type of texture to bake. #### **UV Snapshot** 1. Click **UV Snapshot** tool. 2. After setting the following options, click **Save**. **Options** | **Description** ---|--- **Saving Path** | Specifies the storage path for UV Snapshot. **Size (Pixels)** | Set the size of the image. The image is saved as a square and if the option "Anti-alias Lines" is checked, anti-aliasing is applied to the wire segment. **Edge Color** | Set the color of the wire segment. **UV Area** | **0-1 (Default)** | Save the default 0-1 tile. **Selected Tile** | Save 1 selected tile. If users enter the UV coordinates to be saved, only one tile is saved. **All Tiles** | Save all tiles.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for creating and managing UV maps, offering tools and options for editing, packing, baking textures, and capturing UV snapshots in a user-friendly interface.

title: Create and Edit Zipper
content: **List of Contents** Create Edit Unzip / Zip Set Options **** Create and Edit Zippers quickly and easily. **** #### **Create** 1. Click ![Zipper.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008480088) **Zipper** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click on the 3D garment or 2D Patterns where the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. →Based on the direction the cursor was moved, the segment where the Zipper appears is highlighted in light blue. 3. Double click on the desired endpoint for the Zipper. → One side of the Zipper is created. 4. Click on the Pattern outline where the other side of the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. → Based on the direction the cursor was moved, a blue point appears indicating the same length as the first half of the Zipper that was created. 5. Double click on the blue point. → The Zipper is now complete along with a Puller, a Slider, and a Stopper. 6. Activate the ![Toolbar_3D_Simulation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008384087) → The Zipper simulates being closed. While creating the zipper, press **Esc/C****trl+Z** to cancel all actions, or **Delete/Backspace** to undo the last action. #### **** #### **Edit** 1. Click **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24447291991705)****Edit Zipper** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click the end point of the zipper ▶ Drag in direction to be edited, then Click on the end point of the opposite zipper ▶ Drag it the same way. → A blue dot is displayed at the same point as the opposite length. 3. Drag to the blue dot. → Both lengths of the zipper are modified. **** #### **Unzip / Zip** 1. Click ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976193305) Select/Move tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click & drag on the slider. → The selected slider is highlighted in yellow. 3. Continue to drag the slider. → The slider follows and moves along with the cursor. 4. Release the mouse at the desired position. → The slider is moved to the new location. 5. Activate the ![Toolbar_3D_Simulation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976206233) **Simulate** tool. → The zipper simulates and zips/unzips based on the new location. **** #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the 3D zipper using ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976193305) **Select/Move** tool. 2. Click an option as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete** | Delete the selected Zipper. **Reverse** | Reverse the sewing direction of the zipper tape on the side you right-clicked. **Flip Normal** | Flip the surface of the zipper tape on the side you right-clicked. **Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern** | ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51928260813337) Duplicate the selected zipper to the corresponding symmetric pattern. This option is available only when the zipper is placed on a symmetric pattern or when it does not cross the center line of a half symmetric pattern. **Deactivate/ Freeze** | Deactivate or freeze the selected Zipper. **Reset Slider Arrangement** | Reset the slider's position and angle to default. **Show/Hide** | Show or hide the Slider/ Puller/ Stopper.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for creating, editing, and managing zippers in 3D garment design, offering step-by-step instructions and options for efficient zipper manipulation.

Or click and hold the tool to switch to **![Edit Grading Curve On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452639573401)Edit Curve Grading,![Edit Grading Each On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452639575065) Edit Grading (Each) or ![Edit Grading Curve Each On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655661337)Edit Curve Grading (Each).** **** 2. In the Grading tab of the Object Browser, check the box next to the [Size ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015578947-Add-Adjust-Grading)to be based on to edit the grading value. 3. Click the pattern outline or point to enter the value in Property Editor. _**✨**_**Tip:** You can also move it directly by dragging or using the arrow keys on your keyboard. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Distance** | **Distance** | For each size, set the distance from the segment or point of the base size By default, the grading pattern displays the X and Y axis distances for each size, and you can hide them by clicking the Show icon as needed **Offset** | Set the offset between each size. When the All value is changed, the offset between all sizes is applied equally to the corresponding value. Compare size differences more easily by floating the Grading table! 1. Click on the pattern outline or point with ![Edit Grading On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655621657)Edit Grading tool. 2. Click ![External.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45454479927449)**Undock** button in Property Editor to easily compare size differences. **✨Tip:** Minor calculations, such as adding ease or adjusting measurements, can be performed directly within input fields. (e.g., `10+2`, `20*1.5`, `25-3`, `1/4`). **![Calculation.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45454787578393)** **Size** | Set the size for each graphic grading size. You can also change the unit to a ratio (%). **Lock Aspect Ratio** (Graphic Only) | Graphic can be graded proportionally (X & Y Axis). The **Lock Aspect Ratio** in the **Graphic Property** and the **Graphic Grading Property** are synchronized. **Arrow Key Movement** | Set the movement distance of the arrow keys. #### **** ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51780111264281) #### **Edit Notch Grading** 1. Click ![Edit Grading On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655621657) **Edit Grading** in the 2D toolbar. 2. Select a notch in the 2D Window. _**✨Tip:** To select multiple notches to edit, press the Shift key and click the notches; or click and drag to draw a selection box in the background._ 3. In Property Editor, set the notch grading information. Changes to Notch Distance are instantly applied to the 2D patterns and 3D garment. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Placement** | **Grading Size** | **Fixed** | Notch position is moved by ratio or fixed in a specific position on each size grading. It can be set when importing [DXF](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000493067-2D-Pattern-DXF-Import-Export) files or using the [Notch tool](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013369268-Edit-Notch-Properties). **📝Note:** _When the Fixed option is turned on, the Distance settings will be disabled. To set the distance value, please turn off Fixed option._ **Distance** | **Reverse Direction** | Keep the default moving direction or to reverse the moving direction. **Distance Chart** | The chart shows all the size sets. When inputing the distance value in the chart, notches move according to the pattern outline. **📝Note:** _The selected Base Size is displayed in 0 value and cannot be changed._ _**✨Tip:** Both positive & negative number are supported. When using a negative number, the moving direction will be reversed. _ 4. Sewing lines and graded notches are automatically synced across all size sets to maintain garment fitting accuracy. **** #### **Set Options** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Right-click on the pattern outline and point. → A right-click pop-up menu appears. 3. Click the menu as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Convert to Grade/Non-Grade Point** [**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50833016170905)Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/E83Ye7DZO1s?si=aU_o9zUC2ybi4BuL) | Now you have a regular segment point/curve point, which you can convert to Grade/ Non-Grade points. Only the defined Grade Point follows the grading rule. All the other Points or Non-Grade Points follow the Grade Point movement proportionately. All the Grade Points are represented with a Green Halo & Non-Grade points are just regular points. ![image \(1\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48717464761497) **Remove Graded size** | The grading applied to the selected pattern is removed. **Copy** | Copy the grading value of the selected point. **Paste/ Mirror Paste** | Paste the copied grading values as they are, or paste only the values of the X or Y axis. **Flip Horizontally /Vertically** | The grading applied to the selected segment is flipped horizontally/vertically. **Align** | Rearrange grading by Pattern/Segment/Point. **📝 Note:** You can also align by internal lines and graphics. **** Go back to the List of Contents
