title: Edit Notch Properties
content: 1. Select the notch using the ![Notch On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48650245208217)**Notch** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Set notch properties as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Name** | Change the name for the notch. **Type** | Select the notch shape. **T** | ![tshape.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024213047) **V** | ![vshape.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024296288) **I** | ![ishape.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024213067) **L** | ![__.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360059145773) **U** | ![ushape.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024296248) **Box** | ![boxshape.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024213087) **Angle** | **Perpendicular** | Notch is placed perpendicular to the line. **Custom** | Arbitrarily decide in what angle the notch is created based on the line. **Length** | Edit notch length as needed. This option appears or disappears according to the notch setting under [Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ 2D](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001558747). The notches export in the configured size. **Direction** | Decide in which direction the notch is created. This option is activated only when the notch is created at a corner. **Point (Center)** | Notch is created at the center of two lines making the corner. **Segment 1** | Notch is shifted towards a line. **Segment 2** | Notch is shifted towards the other line. **Notch Placement** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48650245208857) Decide where the notch is located on the Seam Allowance. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50833157563673)](https://youtu.be/sh739ZhJQHw?si=Yr87n9ldy-bJIMiH) **Point (Center)** | Notch is located at the center. **Seamline Extension** | Notch is located and extended from the pattern outline. **Point Perpendicular** | Notch is located and perpendicular to the segment point. **📝Note:** Available only in combination with Direction in Point (Center). **Seam Allowance Perpendicular** | Notch is located and perpendicular to seam allowance. **📝Note:** Available only in combination with Direction in Point (Center). **Flip** | Flip the notch to the other side of the line. **Lock** | Fix the notch position when moving the point of the pattern outline to where the notch was created. **Lock Position** | When setting the notch's fixed position, select the position of the reference point. **Start/End Point** | Set the position to fix the notch. **Grading Size** **(**[**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26243410803481)Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=FG3gZ82C3FAw-ayR&t=2109)**)** | **Fixed** | Instead of moving the notches proportionally with the grading size, it fixes them in a specific position. You can do the same when importing [DXF](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000493067-2D-Pattern-DXF-Import-Export) files. _**✨Tip:**_ Default notch shape and length can be set in [Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ 2D](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001558747).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for using the Notch tool in the 2D design interface, including step-by-step instructions for selecting, customizing, and placing notches on your patterns.

title: Avatar Properties
content: **Set the properties of the avatar.** ### 1. Click an avatar with Select/Move tool. 2. Click an avatar. →The properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust each properties below as needed. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | **Name /** **Item NO.** | Enter a name and an item number of the avatar. **Tech Pack** **(CLO-SET)** | Set whether to include avatar in the Tech Pack or not. **Body Styling** | **Style Configurator** | Set the appearance of the avatar. You can manually set the color of hair, skin, underwear, eyebrows, Eye and lips by clicking the Style Configurator button on the right. **Eye Control** ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=Kw_eMEWqBpsPJlNX&t=1647) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CwB8_ad328M&t=1647s)) | Adjust the position of the avatar's eyes horizontally or vertically. **📝****Note:** This option is only supported for the new avatars available starting with version 7.2. **Surface** | **Skin Offset** | Adjust the distance between the avatar and the garment. Since the avatar and the garment consist of the meshes, a very high value of particle distance and low value of Skin Offset can cause the avatar to protrude out from under the garment. To prevent this, the default Skin Offset value is set to 3mm, which is the proper value for creating a garment. When you fit your garment accurately or create a fitted garment, lower the value of the Skin Offset. **📝****Note:** Leave the default value until you almost finish your garment, since the simulation is being slow when you lower the Skin Offset of the avatar and the Particle Distance of the garment. **Friction** | Increase the friction value to prevent a garment slipped away while draping or animating. **Static** | The friction when a garment is in stationary position. **Kinetic** | The friction when a garment is moving. **Soft Body Simulation** | Apply deformable body simulation to express skin elasticity. This option is available on CLO's default adult avatar, and can only be simulated with garments. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** Enables softbody simulation for custom avatars without skeletons. _* Soft Body Simulation cannot be executed on a Custom Avatar if the mesh contains**holes** or **self-intersections**._ **📝****Note:** Soft body simulation is reflected when recording animation to enable realistic expression, and soft body simulation can also be applied to 3D dummy or scan files converted to CLO avatars. ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=gH3afGW0Szdn4nrZ&t=1881) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRkb4MR0dP0&t=1881s)) **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51882814533785) NVIDIA GPU is supported starting from version 2025.2. **Divide Mesh** | Adjust the number of the avatar's meshes to smooth the surface of the avatar. Be aware to use this feature when it is necessary. The higher you set the meshes, the bigger the size of the file can cause the slower speed of the program. E.g. This works best when you drape a fitted garment such as leggings since the meshes of the avatar appear. **Material** | Set the [Material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures) of the avatar.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to customize and adjust the properties of avatars for enhanced visual and functional performance in design applications.

title: Knit Swatch Editor
content: ## **New in 2025.2** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51521144403865)** **Open Knit Swatch Editor** **Navigation** **Core Settings** **Edit Knit Stitch** **Apply Knit Swatch on 3D Garment** **** Create personalized knit swatches by modifying wales, courses, and yarn thickness; freely customize and edit knit design with available stitch types. _![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51521144405273)Watch Video_ #### **Open Knit Swatch Editor** 1. Select the fabric from the Object Browser, and change the Material Type to **Knitwear** in the Property Editor. 2. Click **Open Knit Swatch Editor** icon ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51553223199129) to open the Editor. _**✨Tip:** The _2D window will be replaced, but you can switch the window by clicking the bottom tab. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51553186132761) #### #### **Navigation** 1. Use the **mouse and keyboard shortcuts** to adjust angles and scales to preview the knit swatch in the Editor. **Action** | **Outcome** ---|--- **Press the middle scroll whell and move** | Pan the window. **Rotate middle scroll whell forward and backward** | Zoom in and out. **Press the right button and move** | Rotate in different degree freely. **Right click** | Show a menu to adjust the desired view angle with and center the knit swatch. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51553829576729) #### **Display Type** 1. Select **Display Type![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554170741273) **on the toggle bar to assist the knit swatch preview and edit process. **Display Type** | **Outcome** ---|--- **Thick Yarn** **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554170741273)** | Show yarn actual thickness and yarn in plain color. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554151478937) **Thin Yarn** **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554170743833)** | Show yarn thickness in line style and yarn in plain color. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554170744601) **Random Color Yarn** **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554151483673)** | Show yarn actual thickness and yarn in random color. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554151486233) #### #### **Core Settings** 1. Change the value to define the swatch repeat's design size, and determine the final output size of the swatch on the 3D garment after the simulation and shrinkage. **Core Setting** | **Outcome** ---|--- **Wales Amount** | Define the number of columns in a swatch repeat. **Courses Amount** | Define the number of rows in a swatch repeat. **Yarn Thickness (mm)** | Determine the diameter of the yarn. **Gauge** | Set the needles per inch. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554735338649)Link** | Link for auto-measurements from current simulated state. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51554749826585)Unlink** | Unlink to input custom swatch measurements in below sub-options. **📝Note:** _When the Gauge and its sub-options are unlinked, the Gauge value serves only as a reference number._ **Wales Per Inch** | Determine the number of columns per inch after shrinkage. **Courses Per Inch** | Determine the number of rows per inch after shrinkage. **Fabric Thickness (mm)** | Determine thickness of the fabric after shrinkage. 2. Click **Reset Swatch** to reset and flatten the swatch with updated knit settings. _**✨Tip:** After changing the settings of Yarn Thickness / Gauge / Wales per inch / Courses Per Inch / Fabric Thickness, the knit swatch will be updated automatically. The Reset Swatch clicking is not required._ #### #### **Edit Knit Stitch** 1. Select the stitch type from the right hand side Toggle menu; or press the shortcut to activate the stitch. 2. Click and drag on the knit swatch and get the live stitch editing. **Knit Stitch Type** | **Outcome** ---|--- **Front Knit (Q)** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555179139225) | Front Knit **Back Knit (W)** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555193698329) | Purl Knit **Front Miss (E)** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555179140633) | Miss Loop in Front & Float in Back **Back Miss (R)** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555179141401) | Miss Loop in Back & Float in Front 3. Click **Simulate (Shortcut: Spacebar)![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555438593945) **to start the Simulation. Apply the shrinkage effect along with Gauge, Wales Per inch, Courses Per Inch, and Fabric Thickness settings on the knit swatch. _**✨Tip:** While simulation is activated, you can edit the knit stitch and get the live update with the shrinkage result._ 4. Click **Simulate (Shortcut: Spacebar)![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51555438596377)** again to pause the Simulation. #### #### **Apply Knit Swatch on 3D Garment** 1. Click **Apply** to apply the knit swatch result on 3D Garment in the 3D Window; or 2. Click **Apply & Close **to apply the knit swatch result to the 3D Garment in the 3D Window. Then close the Knit Swatch Editor and return to the 2D Window; or 3. Click **Close** to close the Knit Swatch Editor and return to the 2D Window. **📝Note:** * After applying settings from the Knit Swatch Editor, the following values in the Property Editor will automatically update: Wales Per Inch, Courses Per Inch, and Fabric Thickness. * When adjusting the value in the Property Editor, the knit swatch on the 3D Garment will update. When this occurs, the Gauge and its sub-options become unlinked.
content_description: Explore the new Open Knit Swatch Editor in 2025.2, allowing you to create and customize personalized knit swatches for your 3D garments with ease.
